title: An evening in Paris
dedication: A postcard you can step inside.
story: Imagine an evening walk along the Seine, with the city glowing around a quiet moment. A postcard you can step inside.

curiosities.title: A river through many chapters
curiosities.text: The banks of the Seine bring together layers of Parisian history, including the Louvre, Notre-Dame and the Eiffel Tower. UNESCO recognizes this riverside ensemble as World Heritage.
